passage.label: Whatever heavens earth exalts Allah Exalted Might Wise; He expelled disbelieving People Scripture homes first gathering you did not think they would leave they thought fortresses protect from Allah decree came unexpected cast terror hearts destroyed houses own hands believers hands take warning people vision; if not decreed evacuation punished world Hereafter punishment Fire; because opposed Allah Messenger whoever opposes severe penalty; palm trees cut down left standing trunks by permission Allah disgrace defiantly disobedient

arabicExcerpts.text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ لِأَوَّلِ ٱلۡحَشۡرِۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْۖ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمۡ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَمۡ يَحۡتَسِبُواْۖ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعۡبَۚ يُخۡرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَأَيۡدِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ فَٱعۡتَبِرُواْ يَـٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
وَلَوۡلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ شَآقُّواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۖ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
مَا قَطَعۡتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوۡ تَرَكۡتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخۡزِيَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ

mainSubject.label: Universal tasbih affirming the Mighty Wise; the expulsion of disbelieving People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering, contrary to both sides' expectations since they trusted fortresses while the decree arrived unperceived and terror was cast into their hearts so they demolished their own houses alongside the believers — a warning addressed to people of vision; had evacuation not been decreed, worldly punishment would have struck with Fire awaiting hereafter; the cause named as opposition to Allah and His Messenger under severity of penalty; the cutting or sparing of palm trees declared to be by divine permission so the defiantly disobedient are disgraced

subordinateSubjects.label: Al-Hashr opens with creation's tasbih declaring Him Mighty and Wise before the expulsion account

Expulsion of the disbelieving People of the Scripture at the first gathering, their fortresses failing as the decree arrived unperceived and terror drove them to demolish their own houses, a warning for people of vision
Had evacuation not been decreed, worldly punishment would have struck with the Fire's punishment awaiting hereafter
The cause named as opposition to Allah and His Messenger, with severity of penalty for whoever opposes
Cutting or sparing palm trees declared to be by divine permission so the defiantly disobedient are disgraced

commandsAndProhibitions.description: So take warning, O people of vision.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Confidence in fortresses shattered by an unperceived decree and terror cast into hearts

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Expulsion from homes at the first gathering with houses demolished by their own hands and the believers'
Cutting or sparing palm trees permitted by Allah to disgrace the defiantly disobedient

relationships.label: Evacuation decreed in place of immediate worldly punishment, with Fire reserved for the Hereafter
Opposition to Allah and His Messenger named as the cause of their penalty

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the palm-tree permission ruling (5) before the fay' distribution block opens (6); P2 ends with the later-generations supplication (10) before the hypocrite-alliance critique begins (11); P3 runs through their broken promises, the Satan parable and the shared Fire outcome (11-17); P4 covers the self-examination command, the forgetting warning, the mountain parable and the closing divine-name sequence (18-24).
